validation_type: Unseen in this research, retrospective; earlier than development, not prospective walk-forward
selection: One fixed candidate selected only using development sample results; freeze before validation. No subsequent holdout-driven retuning.
checks: One tick delayed observed bid/ask execution
success_criteria: Positive equal-weight mean validation-month return, positive majority of six months, and positive equal-weight mean under delayed observed bid/ask execution; report every month and all failures. This is evidence of a candidate, not a promise of live profitability.
exposure: No leverage increase; at most two 0.25 tranches, maximum nominal allocated fraction 0.5
monthly_policy: Reset strategy and capital at each sample start, force liquidation at each sample end. Not a continuous capital or position simulation.
